# FG-DEPLOY-0001

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_expired_approval_blocks_the_deployment` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このデプロイには有効な承認が必要です。承認の期限が切れたか、まだ承認されていません。もう一度デプロイを要求し、承認を受けてください。
- en: This deployment needs a valid approval. The approval has expired or was never given. Request the deployment again and have it approved.
- id: Deployment ini memerlukan persetujuan yang valid. Persetujuan telah kedaluwarsa atau belum diberikan. Minta deployment lagi dan mintalah persetujuan.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C11 (ADR-0031 decisions 6, 7): the environment requires an approval (always for prod) and, when the forge worker took the deployment, a target of the environment had been changed after the approval (`reason=target_changed_after_approval`), or its approval had expired (`approval_expires_at <= now()`, the database clock; `approval_ttl_minutes` of the environment, default 60), or a deployment waited for an approval longer than that window. The deployment ends `blocked`; nothing ran on any target. An approval belongs to one deployment (one SHA) and is never carried over: requesting the same SHA again needs a new approval (ADR-0029 obligation 6).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The worker logs `forge.deploy.blocked` (info) with `error_code`, `request_id`, `deployment_id`, `project_id`, `environment` and `reason=approval_expired`. Read: SELECT id, status, approved_by, approved_at, approval_expires_at, error_code FROM forge.deployments WHERE id = <deployment_id>;

## 対処 (fix)

Request the deployment again (POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/deployments) and approve it within the environment's approval window; raise `approval_ttl_minutes` of the environment if approvals regularly expire before the worker runs (runbook deploy).
